title: Life is Good almost filed for bankruptcy last year. Here's what CEO says saved the retailer
主要内容: Life is Good, a US-based apparel company, shifted its production strategy in 2020 by ordering blank items instead of pre-printed goods. It then produced on-demand based on consumer sentiment, focusing on pandemic-related themes. This approach led to record revenue in 2020, with the CEO stating it was the best top line in 27 years. Sales in 2021 continue to grow as the company adheres to these principles, emphasizing consumer-centric operations. Retailers faced significant challenges last year due to the health crisis, with many filing for bankruptcy and announcing store closures. Life is Good, however, managed to avoid such fate, highlighting a renewed sense of optimism as consumer demand begins to rebound.
